_note: ST7920 128x64 graphic LCD module (serial SPI mode). Pin table from Sitronix ST7920 datasheet (v3.3). 6-pin serial interface header: GND, VCC, CS (chip select, active high), SCLK (serial clock), SID (serial data in), RST# (reset, active low). PSB pin strapped low on module PCB for serial mode (shown on artwork, not electrically modeled). Supports both text (Chinese/ASCII) and graphic framebuffer modes.
